title: Unicode Standard Annex #15: Unicode Normalization Forms, Unicode 17.0.0, Revision 57
claim: Defines Unicode 17 canonical and compatibility equivalence and NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD normalization forms with conformance requirements.

title: Unicode Technical Standard #10: Unicode Collation Algorithm, Unicode 17.0.0, Revision 53
claim: Defines Unicode string collation, DUCET-based ordering, options/tailoring and conformance tests; collation profiles must be versioned.

title: IEEE 754-2019 Standard for Floating-Point Arithmetic
claim: Defines binary and decimal floating-point formats, operations and comparison/order semantics including exceptional values under IEEE 754-2019.

title: ISO/IEC/IEEE 60559-2020 Floating-point arithmetic
claim: International adoption of the IEEE floating-point arithmetic model and specified formats/operations.

title: General Decimal Arithmetic Specification 1.70
claim: Defines language-independent decimal arithmetic, abstract number representation, numeric comparison and representation-preserving decimal semantics used by IEEE decimal arithmetic implementations.

title: RFC 3986 Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax
claim: Defines generic URI syntax and normalization/comparison including case, percent-encoding and dot-segment normalization, while distinguishing scheme-specific normalization.

title: RDF Dataset Canonicalization 1.0
claim: Defines RDFC-1.0 canonicalization of RDF datasets, canonical N-Quads, dataset-isomorphism behavior, error conditions and an official test suite.
